entries.subject: add human-friendly drive names, background mount filter, and unified Partial Expansion
entries.raw_subject: feat(surfaces): add human-friendly drive names, background mount filter, and unified Partial Expansion
entries.description:
Drive mount and eject alerts now show human-friendly volume names and formatted capacities alongside native macOS disk image icons, while automatically filtering out noisy background system mounts such as macOS Update staging volumes (`mnt1`). Power users can optionally re-enable background mount visibility anytime under Settings > System Events > Drive > Advanced, complete with an explanation of what those system mounts are.
Every event with a secondary detail tier across Notch, Dynamic Island, and Pill now uses a unified, more spacious Partial Expansion layout with exclusive expand-on-hover Liquid Glass action buttons, tactile haptics, and checkmark confirmation animations. Completion events such as Download Complete and Install Complete now open Partial Expansion automatically to present immediate actions without requiring a hover, while pointer hover and programmatic triggers share the exact same modular drawer and extensions remain strictly layout-only.
Refs #165

entries.subject: add opt-in host runtime bridges, live audio waveform pill, and Quill v1.7.1 catalog
entries.raw_subject: feat(extensions): add opt-in host runtime bridges, live audio waveform pill, and Quill v1.7.1 catalog
entries.description:
Out-of-process extensions can now subscribe on demand to keyboard modifiers, focused text inputs across macOS and Chromium apps, host-permissioned microphone PCM streaming, managed Parakeet and oMLX local AI runtime wake-up, inline squiggle/underline text annotations, Liquid Glass anchored pills, and live audio waveform capsules without baking extension logic into Archipelago Core.
This also fixes persistent live-activity dismissal and microphone suppression cooldowns, prevents NSHostingView constraint-cycle crashes in floating overlay panels, ensures Store installs and updates restart upgraded extension binaries cleanly, and updates the built-in catalog seed for standalone Quill v1.7.1.

entries.subject: extract Quill out-of-process and expose rich Settings SDUI v2
entries.raw_subject: feat(extensions): extract Quill out-of-process and expose rich Settings SDUI v2
entries.description:
Quill and Voice Transcribe now run completely out-of-process as a standalone extension installable from the Extension Store via verified GitHub Releases, dynamically appearing in the Settings sidebar only when installed and downloading managed local runtimes through AIModelKit with explicit consent.
Extensions can now build native macOS Liquid Glass Settings panes using generic Server-Driven UI controls—including extension headers with collapsible permission summaries, immediate toggles, hover-activated explainer popovers, segmented tier selectors, shortcut recorders, live text inputs, model management cards, and Core-isolated AI provider pickers—backed by bidirectional IPC reactivity and CLI inspection commands.
Every installed extension's Settings pane now automatically includes a host-managed Uninstall section with a confirmation dialog at the bottom, ensuring any extension can be stopped and cleanly removed directly from Settings.

entries.subject: add melt distance, tint depth, clarity, and color tint controls
entries.raw_subject: feat(glass): add melt distance, tint depth, clarity, and color tint controls
entries.description:
Appearance Settings now gives you direct control over how Dynamic Glass and Liquid Glass surfaces blend into your desktop, with live expanded-shelf preview as you tune each slider.
You can adjust Melt Distance to control how far solid black melts into refractive glass, fine-tune Tint Depth to dial smoke darkness without dulling clarity, customize Glass Clarity & Frost on both Dynamic Glass and Liquid Glass, and apply subtle native Glass Color Tint presets or a custom color. Dragging any glass slider temporarily expands the shelf so you see the exact look in real time and collapses it when you release.
Refs #162

entries.subject: multi-download ETA/speed, core hover list, 10pt wing padding, and Store/AI updates
entries.raw_subject: feat(downloads,surface): multi-download ETA/speed, core hover list, 10pt wing padding, and Store/AI updates
entries.description:
Upgrades the Downloads live activity to show an animated 'Downloading' indicator (or 'X Downloading' for simultaneous transfers) in the leading wing and live ETA in the trailing wing across Safari, Chromium, Firefox, AirDrop, and NSProgress transfers, with per-item speed and hover-to-cancel actions in a new reusable core multi-line hover list (SurfaceHoverListView and hoverList.* CLI commands).
Standardizes 10pt visual outer wing padding across Notch, Pill, and Island layouts, eliminates the expanded resting notch secondary surface regression, and includes the pending Store, AIModelKit, Onboarding, What's New, and Quill updates.

entries.subject: restore crystal-clear Dynamic Glass refraction and notch body alignment
entries.raw_subject: fix(glass): restore crystal-clear Dynamic Glass refraction and notch body alignment
entries.description:
Fixes cloudy, blurred, and double-inset rendering on the expanded Dynamic Glass notch so background content remains crisp and refracts sharply along the bottom rim.
Re-pins CABackdropLayer scale to 1.0 after resize and display/occlusion/wake transitions, removes flipped coordinate and CALayer mask overrides on NSGlassEffectView, disables overlay layer-tree auto-flattening, aligns the single-inset 20pt notch body lens with 0.22 smoke and a 0.60 melt stop, and removes the forced frost veil when frost is set to 0%.

entries.subject: Polish notch wings, glows, menu bar controls, and on-demand AI lifecycle
entries.raw_subject: feat(surface): Polish notch wings, glows, menu bar controls, and on-demand AI lifecycle
entries.description:
Refines Archipelago's notch, Island, Pill, Voice Transcribe, and Menu Bar experience (#124–#140):
- **Notch & Wing Polish**: Forces solid black wings for system event notifications on notched MacBooks while preserving themes for the expanded shelf, standardizes even 4px wing padding without 3-digit width reservation, and centralizes all surface, icon, and settings colors into a single shared palette. - **Microanimations & Surface Glows**: Makes volume and brightness number rolls directional (up when increasing, down when decreasing), adds hover/pulse microanimations to update download and install buttons, and adds pulsing green charging, 20% yellow/orange plug-in reminder, and red low-battery glows behind surfaces. Non-DMG download notifications now auto-dismiss on the timer. - **Voice Transcribe & On-Demand AI Lifecycle**: Adds an audio-reactive green glow, elapsed recording timer, hands-free Pause/Cancel/Done controls, a pulsing 'Transcribing…' state, and language disclosure. Local AI runtimes (Parakeet and Gemma oMLX) now load on demand with a configurable idle auto-unload timeout (default 20m) and ready countdown (default 3s). - **Menu Bar Refinements**: Removes theme and surface toggles, moves Onboarding & Permissions under Settings -> Updates, adds a bottom version footer, and adds overflow menus for Dock Widgets, Quill (with customizable Pause/Stop shortcuts), and AI Models (showing per-model Load/Unload). Also fixes a Settings window NSHostingController resize crash during Parakeet setup.

entries.raw_subject: fix(quill): add calibratedOrigin support to TextSelectionMonitor.estimateTextSelectionRect
entries.description: Include the calibratedOrigin parameter used by QuillAXGeometryResolver for fallback text-selection rect calibration so clean checkouts and CI release builds compile cleanly.

entries.subject: restore native tooltip suppression within live Dock slab while preserving auto-hide and zero cursor jump (#152)
entries.raw_subject: fix(dock): restore native tooltip suppression within live Dock slab while preserving auto-hide and zero cursor jump (#152)
entries.description:
Hovering across Dock icons now clears macOS's native tooltip immediately without leaving the first icon's label stuck on subsequent icons, while keeping Dock previews open smoothly across the icon-to-popover bridge.
Auto-hide still engages cleanly when moving out of previews or vertically expanded Dock widgets, with zero cursor jumping and zero window resizing.

entries.subject: prevent cursor jump on Dock widget exit and avoid synthetic Dock re-reveal (#152)
entries.raw_subject: fix(dock): prevent cursor jump on Dock widget exit and avoid synthetic Dock re-reveal (#152)
entries.description:
Moving out of a vertically expanded Dock widget or Dock preview popover no longer warps the pointer or triggers synthetic Dock events that keep an auto-hidden Dock revealed.
Dock previews now stay visible while your pointer is inside the popover even as the macOS Dock naturally auto-hides underneath, keeping window sizes untouched.

entries.subject: add missing QuillAXGeometryResolver and QuillElectronSimulationHarness files
entries.raw_subject: fix(quill): add missing QuillAXGeometryResolver and QuillElectronSimulationHarness files
entries.description: Include the two Quill helper files referenced by QuillInputMonitor and SurfaceCommandRegistry+QuillCommands so clean checkouts build and deploy cleanly.

entries.subject: auto-hide Dock reliably after exiting previews and vertical widgets (#152)
entries.raw_subject: fix(dock): auto-hide Dock reliably after exiting previews and vertical widgets (#152)
entries.description:
When macOS Dock auto-hide is enabled, moving your cursor out of a Dock preview popover or a vertically expanded Dock widget now lets the Dock hide immediately without needing to swipe back down to the bottom screen edge.
Archipelago preserves macOS's overlay auto-hide mode throughout the interaction so desktop windows never resize or jump when hovering Dock previews or widgets.

entries.subject: Polish download & DMG install notifications, wing hover stability, and CPU usage
entries.raw_subject: fix(downloads): Polish download & DMG install notifications, wing hover stability, and CPU usage
entries.description:
Improves the download, DMG install, and wing hover experience across Notch, Island, and Pill surfaces (#141–#151):
- **Stable Wing Hover & Clicks**: Adds an 80ms intentional hover-entry linger when a right-wing action button is present, hides redundant right-wing buttons while the hover drawer is open without jumping width, and restricts top-bar tap handling so clicking Dismiss or other drawer buttons never triggers the compact right-wing action. - **Post-Install & Completed Download Actions**: Defaults the post-install right-wing action to Open App (honoring auto-delete DMG on open), dismisses the notification after moving the DMG to Trash, and replaces Cancel Download on completed downloads with minimal icon-only Open, Go to location (revealing the file in Finder), and Dismiss buttons. - **Download Wing Formatting & Performance**: Shows 'Downloaded' with a green checkmark and properly colored browser icons, prevents new notifications from auto-expanding their hover drawer, and eliminates CPU/RAM spikes during download progress by deduplicating identical progress updates and reducing directory polling to 0.75s.
